entity_classes: {"Algorithm": {"comment": "A complete parametric definition \u2014 the top-level container for the computational process. Maps to a Grasshopper definition file (the whole canvas). Every Interface is necessarily an Input OR an Output (owl:disjointUnionOf).", "iri": "http://example.org/design-grammar/comp#Interface", "label": "Interface", "local_name": "dgc:Interface"}, "Parameter": {"comment": "A typed value in a parametric definition \u2014 data flowing through the computation graph. Bridge: Atoms can reference Parameters via dgc:attributeOf. Every Parameter is necessarily a VariableParam, ConstantParam, OR EmergentParam (owl:disjointUnionOf).", "iri": "http://example.org/design-grammar/comp#Parameter", "label": "Parameter", "local_name": "dgc:Parameter"}, "Pattern": {"comment": "The atomic unit of parametric computation \u2014 a single operation node. Maps to a Grasshopper Component (a node on the canvas). Has Interfaces (I/O ports) and receives Parameters. Patterns can host other Patterns (nesting). Example: '11_Pat_DivideLine', '11_Pat_TopChord', '12_Pat_1 - Create footer bottom lines'.", "iri": "http://example.org/design-grammar/comp#Pattern", "label": "Pattern", "local_name": "dgc:Pattern"}, "Procedure": {"comment": "A grouped sequence of Patterns within an Algorithm \u2014 an organizational unit of computation.
